en: The Principality of Jersika, in Latin terra Lettia, as a principality in what is now eastern Latvia
Its rule by local princes on the Daugava and its conquest by the Teutonic Order
zh: 杰西卡公国在拉丁文中称莱蒂亚，是今拉脱维亚东部的公国
由道加瓦河畔的本地王公统治，后被条顿骑士团征服

politics.zh: 杰西卡公国在拉丁文中称莱蒂亚，是今拉脱维亚东部的公国，12世纪起见于记载，位于道加瓦河中游，以杰西卡要塞为中心。它由本地拉特加莱王公统治，与波洛茨克、立陶宛及诺夫哥罗德互动，控制道加瓦河的贸易与渡口；1209年被利沃尼亚骑士团攻占，其地被并入利沃尼亚领域，王公成为附庸。
politics.en: The Principality of Jersika, in Latin terra Lettia, was a principality in what is now eastern Latvia, recorded from the twelfth century and lying on the middle Daugava with the fortress of Jersika as its centre. Ruled by local Latgalian princes, it interacted with Polotsk, Lithuania and Novgorod and controlled the trade and crossings of the Daugava; in 1209 it was taken by the Livonian Brothers of the Sword and its lands were incorporated into Livonia, its princes becoming vassals.

economy.zh: 经济以道加瓦河的贸易、渡口税收、农业与林业为基础，河流连接波罗的海与罗斯商路，谷物、毛皮、蜂蜡与亚麻是重要交换物，要塞控制航道与陆路。
economy.en: The economy rested on trade on the Daugava, tolls at the crossings, farming and forestry, with the river linking the Baltic with the routes of the Rus lands, grain, furs, wax and flax among the goods exchanged, and the fortress controlling both water and land routes.

culture.zh: 杰西卡公国处于波罗的与斯拉夫文化交汇处，本地多神信仰与东正教、天主教先后传入，木造要塞与山丘遗址留下考古遗存，编年史记录了王公与骑士团的冲突。
culture.en: The principality lay where Baltic and Slav cultures met, local pagan beliefs and then Orthodox and Catholic Christianity arriving in turn, its timber fortresses and hill sites leaving archaeological remains, and chronicles recording the conflicts between its princes and the Order.

events.zh: 关键节点包括12世纪公国的形成、与波洛茨克及立陶宛的互动、1209年被利沃尼亚骑士团攻占，以及此后并入利沃尼亚并成为附庸，这些事件决定了波罗的海东岸的中世纪归属。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the principality in the twelfth century, its dealings with Polotsk and Lithuania, its capture by the Livonian Brothers of the Sword in 1209 and its later incorporation into Livonia as a vassal, events that determined the medieval allegiance of the eastern Baltic coast.

value.zh: 位于道加瓦河中游，今拉脱维亚东部。
value.en: It lay on the middle Daugava, in what is now eastern Latvia.
It was taken by the Livonian Brothers of the Sword in 1209.

en: Rheged as one of the kingdoms of the Hen Ogledd, the Old North, in post-Roman Britain
Its rule in what is now south-western Scotland and northern England and its memory in Welsh poetry
zh: 雷格德是后罗马时代不列颠“旧北境”诸王国之一
位于今苏格兰西南与英格兰北部，在威尔士诗歌中留有名声

politics.zh: 雷格德是后罗马时代不列颠“旧北境”诸王国之一，位于今苏格兰西南与英格兰北部一带，6世纪起见于威尔士诗歌与编年记载，由本地不列颠王统统治。它与达尔里阿达、伯尼西亚及诺森布里亚互动，控制索尔韦湾与爱尔兰海沿岸的交通；7世纪后逐步被诺森布里亚吞并，其地并入盎格鲁-撒克逊王国。
politics.en: Rheged was one of the kingdoms of the Hen Ogledd, the Old North, in post-Roman Britain, in what is now south-western Scotland and northern England, recorded from the sixth century in Welsh poetry and chronicles and ruled by a local British royal line. It interacted with Dal Riata, Bernicia and Northumbria and controlled movement around the Solway Firth and the Irish Sea coast; after the seventh century it was gradually absorbed by Northumbria and its lands were incorporated into that Anglo-Saxon kingdom.

economy.zh: 经济以爱尔兰海沿岸的农业、畜牧、渔业与沿海贸易为基础，索尔韦湾一带的牧场与耕地提供生计，与爱尔兰及威尔士方向的往来见于记载，牲畜与谷物是主要财富。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, herding, fishing and coastal trade around the Irish Sea, with pastures and arable land near the Solway Firth providing a livelihood, contacts with Ireland and Wales recorded, and livestock and grain the main forms of wealth.

culture.zh: 雷格德是不列颠北部口传诗歌的重要背景，威尔士诗歌传统中的统治者乌里恩与其子成为传奇人物，早期不列颠语地名与石刻见于该地区，基督教修道院在6世纪后建立。
culture.en: Rheged is an important setting for the oral poetry of northern Britain, the ruler Urien and his son becoming legendary figures in Welsh poetic tradition, early Brittonic place names and carved stones being found in the area, and Christian monasteries being founded after the sixth century.

events.zh: 关键节点包括6世纪王国的形成、与达尔里阿达及伯尼西亚的互动、7世纪诺森布里亚的扩张，以及此后该地被吞并并成为盎格鲁-撒克逊王国的一部分，这些事件构成后罗马时代不列颠北部政治史的一环。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the kingdom in the sixth century, its dealings with Dal Riata and Bernicia, the expansion of Northumbria in the seventh and the later absorption of its lands into that Anglo-Saxon kingdom, events that form part of the political history of northern Britain in the post-Roman period.

value.zh: 位于今苏格兰西南与英格兰北部。
value.en: It lay in what is now south-western Scotland and northern England.

value.zh: 其统治者在威尔士诗歌中成为传奇人物。
value.en: Its rulers became legendary figures in Welsh poetry.

en: The Principality of Galicia, in Ukrainian Halych, as a Rus principality in the south-west of the Rus lands
Its rule by the Rostislavichi and its union with Volhynia
zh: 加里奇公国是罗斯西南部的罗斯公国
由罗斯季斯拉维奇家族统治，后与沃里尼亚合并

politics.zh: 加里奇公国是罗斯西南部的罗斯公国，12世纪自弗拉基米尔-沃里尼亚地区分出，以加里奇为中心，领有喀尔巴阡山北麓与德涅斯特河上游一带。它由罗斯季斯拉维奇家族统治，与基辅、匈牙利、波兰及库曼人互动，控制盐与商路贸易；1199年与沃里尼亚合并为加利奇-沃里尼亚公国，成为罗斯西南部的强权。
politics.en: The Principality of Galicia, in Ukrainian Halych, was a Rus principality in the south-west of the Rus lands that separated from the Vladimir-Volhynia area in the twelfth century, centred on Halych and holding the northern slopes of the Carpathians and the upper Dniester. Ruled by the Rostislavichi family, it interacted with Kiev, Hungary, Poland and the Cumans and controlled the salt and trade routes; in 1199 it was united with Volhynia to form the Principality of Galicia-Volhynia, a leading power in the south-west of the Rus lands.

economy.zh: 经济以喀尔巴阡山北麓的农业、盐矿、畜牧与商路贸易为基础，加里奇的盐矿是重要财源，德涅斯特河与陆路连接波罗的海与黑海方向，谷物、盐与毛皮是重要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming on the northern slopes of the Carpathians, salt mining, herding and trade along the routes, with the salt mines of Halych an important source of revenue, the Dniester and land routes linking the Baltic and Black Sea directions, and grain, salt and furs among the goods exchanged.

culture.zh: 加里奇公国留下东正教教堂与修道院遗产，编年史记录了其王公与对外战争，教会斯拉夫语用于文书，建筑与圣像画延续罗斯传统，与拜占庭及巴尔干的文化联系密切。
culture.en: The principality left an Orthodox heritage of churches and monasteries, its chronicles recording its princes and foreign wars, Church Slavonic serving its documents, its architecture and icon painting continuing Rus tradition, and its cultural links with Byzantium and the Balkans close.

events.zh: 关键节点包括12世纪公国的分出、罗斯季斯拉维奇家族的统治、与匈牙利及波兰的战争，以及1199年与沃里尼亚合并为加利奇-沃里尼亚公国，这些事件决定了罗斯西南部的政治格局。
events.en: Key moments are the separation of the principality in the twelfth century, the rule of the Rostislavichi, its wars with Hungary and Poland and its union with Volhynia in 1199 to form Galicia-Volhynia, events that determined the political order of the south-west of the Rus lands.

value.en: In 1199 it was united with Volhynia.

en: The County of Holland as a state of the Holy Roman Empire in the Low Countries
Its rule by the House of Holland and its emergence as a leading maritime and commercial region
zh: 荷兰伯国是低地地区的神圣罗马帝国邦国
由荷兰家族统治，逐步成为海上与商业要地

politics.zh: 荷兰伯国是低地地区的神圣罗马帝国邦国，10世纪起在莱茵河与马斯河三角洲一带形成，由本地伯爵家族统治，以海牙与多德雷赫特为中心。它通过围海造田与水利工程扩大耕地，发展渔业、航运与市镇贸易，与乌得勒支、佛兰德及后来的勃艮第家族互动；15世纪归勃艮第家族统治，其地成为后来的荷兰省。
politics.en: The County of Holland was a state of the Holy Roman Empire in the Low Countries that took shape from the tenth century in the delta of the Rhine and Meuse under a local comital family, centred on The Hague and Dordrecht. It extended its farmland through land reclamation and water works, developed fishing, shipping and urban trade and interacted with Utrecht, Flanders and later the Burgundians; in the fifteenth century it came under Burgundian rule and its lands became the later province of Holland.

economy.zh: 经济以围海造田的农业、渔业、航运与市镇贸易为基础，三角洲的水利工程与堤坝系统扩大耕地，鲱鱼渔业与波罗的海航运是重要财源，多德雷赫特与阿姆斯特丹等市镇逐步兴起。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming on reclaimed land, fishing, shipping and urban trade, with the water works and dykes of the delta extending arable land, the herring fishery and Baltic shipping important sources of revenue, and towns such as Dordrecht and Amsterdam gradually rising.

culture.zh: 荷兰伯国时期市镇自治与水利管理制度发展，教堂与市政建筑留下遗存，荷兰语文献与地方习惯法记录其制度，绘画与印刷业在近代早期兴盛，与汉萨及北海贸易圈联系密切。
culture.en: In the period of the county urban self-government and water management institutions developed, churches and civic buildings surviving as remains, Dutch documents and local customary law recording its institutions, painting and printing flourishing in the early modern period, and its links with the Hanseatic and North Sea trading world close.

events.zh: 关键节点包括10世纪伯国的形成、中世纪的水利与市镇发展、15世纪归勃艮第家族统治，以及此后成为荷兰省并参与反抗西班牙的起义，这些事件决定了该地区在近代早期的地位。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the county in the tenth century, the water works and urban growth of the Middle Ages, its passage to Burgundian rule in the fifteenth century and its later existence as the province of Holland and part in the revolt against Spain, events that determined the position of the region in the early modern period.

value.zh: 位于莱茵河与马斯河三角洲。
value.en: It lay in the delta of the Rhine and Meuse.

value.zh: 15世纪归勃艮第家族统治，后成为荷兰省。
value.en: It passed to Burgundian rule in the fifteenth century and became the province of Holland.

en: The Free County of Burgundy, in French the Franche-Comte, as a territory of the Holy Roman Empire
Its rule by the Habsburgs and its passage to France in the seventeenth century
zh: 勃艮第伯国又称自由伯国，法语称弗朗什-孔泰，是神圣罗马帝国的领地
由哈布斯堡家族统治，17世纪归法国

politics.zh: 勃艮第伯国又称自由伯国，法语称弗朗什-孔泰，是神圣罗马帝国的领地，位于今法国东部，10世纪起在汝拉山脉一带形成，由本地伯爵家族统治，以多勒与贝桑松为中心。它先后归勃艮第公爵与哈布斯堡家族统治，在法国与帝国之间长期争夺；1678年《奈梅亨条约》后归法国，其地成为法国的弗朗什-孔泰地区。
politics.en: The Free County of Burgundy, in French the Franche-Comte, was a territory of the Holy Roman Empire in what is now eastern France, taking shape from the tenth century in the Jura region under local counts, centred on Dole and Besancon. It passed in turn to the dukes of Burgundy and the Habsburgs and was long contested between France and the empire; by the treaty of Nijmegen in 1678 it passed to France and its lands became the French region of Franche-Comte.

economy.zh: 经济以汝拉山区的农业、畜牧、盐业、林业与钟表与金属手工业为基础，盐泉与森林是重要资源，市镇参与跨区域贸易，山地牧场支撑乳酪与畜牧业。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, herding, salt working, forestry and watchmaking and metal crafts in the Jura, with salt springs and forests important resources, its towns taking part in interregional trade, and mountain pastures supporting cheese making and livestock raising.

culture.zh: 勃艮第伯国保存罗马式与哥特式教堂、城堡与盐场遗产，贝桑松的城堡与老城具有特色，法语与地方方言并存，钟表与机械工艺传统延续至今。
culture.en: The county preserves Romanesque and Gothic churches, castles and saltworks, the citadel and old town of Besancon being distinctive, French and local dialects coexisting, and its watchmaking and mechanical craft traditions continuing to this day.

events.zh: 关键节点包括10世纪伯国的形成、14至15世纪归勃艮第公爵与哈布斯堡家族、16至17世纪法国与西班牙的争夺，以及1678年《奈梅亨条约》后归法国，这些事件决定了该地区的现代归属。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the county in the tenth century, its passage to the dukes of Burgundy and the Habsburgs in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, the contest between France and Spain in the sixteenth and seventeenth and its transfer to France by the treaty of Nijmegen in 1678, events that determined the modern allegiance of the region.

value.zh: 神圣罗马帝国的领地，又称自由伯国。
value.en: It was a territory of the Holy Roman Empire, also called the Free County.
It passed to France by the treaty of Nijmegen in 1678.

en: The Sarukhanids, also known as the Beylik of Saruhan, as a Turkish principality in western Anatolia
Its rule from Manisa and its incorporation into the Ottoman state
zh: 萨鲁汗侯国又称萨鲁汗王朝，是安纳托利亚西部的突厥公国
以马尼萨为中心，后并入奥斯曼国家

politics.zh: 萨鲁汗侯国又称萨鲁汗王朝，是安纳托利亚西部的突厥公国，14世纪初在塞尔柱与蒙古势力衰落后兴起，以马尼萨为中心，领有今马尼萨与伊兹密尔一带。它参与爱琴海沿岸的贸易与海上活动，与拜占庭、艾登侯国及热那亚互动；1390年被奥斯曼帝国吞并，1402年后一度复立，1410年前后最终并入奥斯曼。
politics.en: The Sarukhanids, also known as the Beylik of Saruhan, were a Turkish principality in western Anatolia that emerged in the early fourteenth century as Seljuk and Mongol power declined, centred on Manisa and holding the area of modern Manisa and Izmir. It took part in trade and seaborne activity along the Aegean coast and interacted with Byzantium, the Aydinid beylik and Genoa; it was absorbed by the Ottomans in 1390, briefly restored after 1402 and finally incorporated into the Ottoman state around 1410.

economy.zh: 经济以盖迪兹河谷的农业、棉花种植、手工业与爱琴海沿岸贸易为基础，马尼萨是市场与行政中心，棉花、谷物与纺织品是重要交换物，港口连接意大利与黎凡特商路。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Gediz valley, cotton growing, crafts and trade along the Aegean coast, with Manisa a market and administrative centre, cotton, grain and textiles among the goods exchanged, and its ports linking Italian and Levantine routes.

culture.zh: 萨鲁汗侯国赞助伊斯兰建筑与学术，马尼萨的清真寺、经学院与商队客栈留下遗存，突厥语与波斯语文化在宫廷交汇，与拜占庭及热那亚社群的文化接触见于记载。
culture.en: The beylik patronised Islamic architecture and learning, the mosques, colleges and caravanserais of Manisa surviving as remains, Turkish and Persian culture meeting at its court, and cultural contact with Byzantine and Genoese communities being recorded.

events.zh: 关键节点包括14世纪初公国的兴起、爱琴海沿岸的贸易与海上活动、1390年被奥斯曼吞并、1402年后短暂复立，以及1410年前后最终并入奥斯曼，这些事件构成安纳托利亚诸贝伊国被统一的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the rise of the principality in the early fourteenth century, its trade and seaborne activity along the Aegean, its absorption by the Ottomans in 1390, its brief restoration after 1402 and its final incorporation around 1410, events that make up the history of the Anatolian beyliks being unified.

value.en: It was finally incorporated into the Ottoman state around 1410.

en: Iceland as a Nordic island country between the Arctic Ocean and the North Atlantic
Its settlement in the ninth century, its medieval commonwealth and its modern republic
zh: 冰岛是北欧岛国，位于北冰洋与北大西洋之间
9世纪有人定居，中世纪曾建立自由邦，近代为共和国

politics.zh: 冰岛是北欧岛国，位于北冰洋与北大西洋之间，首都为雷克雅未克。它9世纪由北欧移民定居，930年建立以议会与酋长制为基础的自由邦，1262年归挪威王权，后随丹麦统治；1874年获得自治，1918年成为丹麦国王治下的主权国家，1944年建立共和国，是北约与欧洲自由贸易联盟成员。
politics.en: Iceland is a Nordic island country between the Arctic Ocean and the North Atlantic, with Reykjavik as its capital. It was settled by Norse migrants in the ninth century and in 930 established a commonwealth based on an assembly and chieftaincies, came under Norwegian royal rule in 1262 and later Danish rule; it gained home rule in 1874, became a sovereign state under the Danish crown in 1918 and founded a republic in 1944, and is a member of NATO and the European Free Trade Association.

economy.zh: 经济以渔业与水产加工、铝冶炼、旅游业与服务业为基础，渔业与海产品出口长期是经济支柱，地热与水力发电支撑能源密集型产业，旅游业在近年快速增长。
economy.en: The economy rests on fishing and fish processing, aluminium smelting, tourism and services, with fisheries and seafood exports long the mainstay, geothermal and hydropower supporting energy-intensive industry, and tourism growing quickly in recent years. Its fisheries remain central to exports and employment.

culture.zh: 冰岛文化以冰岛语与中世纪萨迦文学为基础，议会与口传诗歌传统悠久，埃达与萨迦手稿被列为世界遗产，音乐与文学创作活跃，火山与冰川地貌构成自然与文化景观。
culture.en: Icelandic culture rests on the Icelandic language and medieval saga literature, with a long tradition of assemblies and oral poetry, the Edda and saga manuscripts listed as World Heritage, music and literary writing active, and its volcanic and glacial landscapes shaping the natural and cultural setting.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪的定居、930年自由邦的建立、1262年归挪威王权、1918年成为主权国家，以及1944年建立共和国，这些事件构成冰岛从定居到现代国家的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the settlement of the ninth century, the founding of the commonwealth in 930, its passage to Norwegian royal rule in 1262, its becoming a sovereign state in 1918 and the founding of the republic in 1944, events that make up the history of Iceland from settlement to modern statehood.

en: The Despotate of Arta as a state in what is now north-western Greece and southern Albania
Its rule by the Tocco family and its conquest by the Ottomans in the fifteenth century
zh: 阿尔塔专制国是今希腊西北与阿尔巴尼亚南部的政权
由托科家族统治，15世纪被奥斯曼征服

politics.zh: 阿尔塔专制国是今希腊西北与阿尔巴尼亚南部的政权，14世纪后期在伊庇鲁斯专制国瓦解后由阿尔巴尼亚与意大利家族建立，以阿尔塔为中心，由托科家族长期统治。它控制爱奥尼亚海沿岸的港口与内陆山地，与威尼斯、奥斯曼、塞尔维亚及本地阿尔巴尼亚贵族互动；1449年被奥斯曼帝国征服，其地并入奥斯曼的伊庇鲁斯地区。
politics.en: The Despotate of Arta was a state in what is now north-western Greece and southern Albania, established in the later fourteenth century after the break-up of the Despotate of Epirus, with Arta as its centre and long ruled by the Tocco family. It controlled the ports of the Ionian coast and the mountains inland and interacted with Venice, the Ottomans, Serbia and local Albanian nobles; in 1449 it was conquered by the Ottoman empire and its lands were incorporated into Ottoman Epirus.

economy.zh: 经济以爱奥尼亚海沿岸的港口贸易、渔业、农业与山地畜牧为基础，阿尔塔与约阿尼纳是商业中心，盐、谷物、葡萄酒与皮革是重要交换物，威尼斯商人参与贸易。
economy.en: The economy rested on port trade along the Ionian coast, fishing, farming and mountain herding, with Arta and Ioannina as centres of commerce, salt, grain, wine and hides among the goods exchanged, and Venetian merchants taking part in the trade.

culture.zh: 阿尔塔专制国处于希腊、阿尔巴尼亚与意大利文化交汇处，东正教与天主教社群并存，教堂与修道院留下遗存，希腊语与阿尔巴尼亚语并用，地方贵族与骑士制度延续。
culture.en: The despotate lay where Greek, Albanian and Italian cultures met, Orthodox and Catholic communities coexisting, its churches and monasteries surviving as remains, Greek and Albanian both in use, and local noble and chivalric institutions continuing.

events.zh: 关键节点包括14世纪后期政权的建立、托科家族的长期统治、与威尼斯及奥斯曼的互动，以及1449年被奥斯曼征服，这些事件决定了伊庇鲁斯在15世纪的归属。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the state in the later fourteenth century, the long rule of the Tocco family, its dealings with Venice and the Ottomans and its conquest by the Ottomans in 1449, events that determined the allegiance of Epirus in the fifteenth century.

value.en: It was conquered by the Ottoman empire in 1449.
